title: ParameterDict implementation is not torchscript compatible
author: DaRealNim

comments.author: DaRealNim
comments.body: I tried hacking around this issue by using a list instead of a set for ParameterDict, but I just realized that HGTConv would not be jittable anyway due to the tuple as dictionnary keys issues detailed at #4246. I'm going to try reimplementing functions that use `Dict[EdgeType, ...]` used by HGTConv to use a  `Dict[str, ...]` instead where the edge type is something like `"nodetype1__edgetype__nodetype2"`

comments.author: akihironitta
comments.body: Closing this issue because TorchScript has been unmaintained for 3+ years, and PyTorch 2.9 has deprecated its support in favor of PT2 stack.
